description: Martian Mobile's public Claude Code plugins — quant research and trading-ops tooling, sanitized from internal workflows.

plugins.name: backtest2live
plugins.description: Check a backtest against what live execution would do, run locally. Three checks: convergence across a variant sweep (CONVERGED / ITERATE / KILL), fill-gap for resting orders against a queue proxy, cost-gap for taker orders against the real book. Wraps the backtest2live CLI.
